About Fidelity International
Fidelity International offers world class investment solutions and retirement expertise. As a privately owned, independent company, investment is our only business. We are driven by the needs of our clients, not by shareholders. Our vision is to deliver innovative client solutions for a better future.
Our people are passionate, engaged, smart and curious, and we give them the independence and the confidence to make a difference. While we take pride in the excellence of our investment solutions and client service, we know we can always do better. We are honest, respectful and make tough calls, challenging the status quo to achieve better outcomes through innovation. Above all else, we always put our clients first.
About Fidelity Dalian
Established in 2007, FIL Technology (Dalian) Limited was the Fidelity’s first wholly owned enterprise in China. The Dalian office initially served as a systems development centre to bolster Fidelity’s growing business in the Asia Pacific region, with a primary focus on providing technology and web-based support and services. The office has continued to expand in recent years and now acts as the central service hub for the Asia Pacific region supporting multiple business functions including systems development and support, systems infrastructure support, retail operations, finance accounting services and investment administration & fund accounting.
Team Description
Asset Management CAO
team
is responsible front to back, for the operational and supporting capabilities across investment management.
The Investment Management Solutions team
is a cross asset delivery & support function driving collaboration, consistency & execution across the global asset management platform. The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the
Sustainable Investing Solutions team
is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.
About Your Role
As the
SI Solutions - Analyst
, you will play a key role in supporting the firm’s stewardship activities. Your responsibilities will include analyzing shareholder meeting agendas, providing insightful voting recommendations, and executing high‑quality, timely proxy votes in alignment with the firm’s policies and fiduciary duties. You will also contribute to policy development and ongoing process improvements. In this role, you will collaborate closely with investment teams, Sustainable Investing analysts, and proxy service providers to strengthen the firm’s governance framework and enhance our stewardship outcomes.
About You
The successful candidate will be a detail‑oriented governance professional with demonstrated expertise in applying in‑house voting policies and conducting precise research on investee AGM/EGM agendas. This role requires performing accurate analysis in complex or non‑standard voting scenarios and consistently delivering timely, high‑quality voting instructions. With a growing understanding of Sustainable Investing functions, the candidate is expected to operate with strong process discipline, overseeing end‑to‑end vote execution, quality assurance, and pipeline management. As the global regulations related to Sustainable Investing continue to evolve rapidly, the candidate must be able to learn, adapt, and refine deliverables to meet emerging requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Review and analyze FIL Investee companies’ global shareholder meeting agendas, focusing on complex corporate governance, remuneration, and ESG related proposals.
Conduct researches and FIL voting policy application by leveraging FIL’s research capabilities, in-house voting policy, and external research resources to make thorough and informed voting recommendations for Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team.
Assist Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team in engagement activities with investee companies on governance and sustainability topics.
Handle end-to-end vote execution processes to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. Provide non-standard voting support to address specific client requirements.
Coordinate with external proxy advisors, custodians, and voting platforms to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
Contribute to periodic reviews and updates of proxy voting policies and procedures. Monitor regulatory and market developments in governance, stewardship, and ESG.
Support the preparation of stewardship reports, respond to client inquiries, and complete regulatory disclosures.
Support the implementation of new voting strategies and practices, and identify, drive and contribute to continuous process improvementation.
Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.
Experience And Qualifications Required
Education in Finance, Business, Economics, Sustainability Investment or related field. Master degree is preferred.
Experience in researches and analysis in proxy voting, corporate governance, stewardship, ESG or Sustainable Investing is a strong plus.
Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to interpret corporate filings and governance documents.
Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail and accuracy in a high volume, deadline driven environment.
Data analytical and automation skills (Python/SQL/PowerBI), experience of developing automation for business processes is highly preferred. Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
Proficient in using AI tools to improve efficiency, ensure accuracy, and solve business problems.
Highly efficient English communication skills, both written and verbal is mandatory.
Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA, FRM related certificate is highly preferred.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is required. Proven record to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.
A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.
Feel rewarded
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. Drive the integration of AI/ML capabilities into production systems with appropriate controls for governance, model risk, explainability and data privacy.
Collaborate with product, security, ops and data teams to prioritise technical debt, reliability improvements and platform investments.
Represent engineering in stakeholder forums, technical governance boards and external partner engagements.
What you will be doing
Act as the technical owner for core platform domains, driving architecture, design and delivery across backend, data streaming and cloud infrastructure; focus deeply on 2–3 areas (e.g., Java/Spring, Kafka/Stream Processing, Cloud/Kubernetes).
Lead targeted technical deep‑dives (2–3 per quarter) to resolve architectural trade‑offs, eliminate chronic pain points and transfer knowledge across teams.
Own and deliver the Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items for your area: define remediations, coordinate cross‑functional delivery, produce evidence for audits and close out controls.
Run structured root‑cause analysis and blameless post‑mortems for major incidents, translate findings into prioritized fixes, and ensure follow‑through.
Provide hands‑on technical direction: participate in design reviews, code reviews, prototyping and proof‑of‑concepts to validate architecture decisions.
Mentor senior engineers and engineering leads; raise team capability through coaching, workshops and documented standards/patterns.
Collaborate with product, security, data and ops to align technical strategy with business objectives, regulatory requirements and non‑functional goals (scalability, resilience, security).
Drive adoption of cloud‑native and DevOps practices (CI/CD, observability) and ensure production readiness for new services and AI/ML components.
Qualifications
Certifications & Education
University degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline; MSc/PhD preferred.
Cloud certification(s) strongly preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
Desirable: Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD), security or data governance certificates.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in financial services or regulated industries with demonstrable knowledge of regulatory controls, audit preparation and model risk governance.
Contributions to open source projects or academic/industry research; speaker at technical conferences is a plus.
Proven ability to lead cross‑functional engineering teams through technological transformations, and to operationalise AI safely at scale.
Deliverables & Success Measures
Architecture and platform designs that meet non‑functional requirements (scalability, resiliency, security).
Successful delivery of prioritized Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items and remediation actions.
Reduction in incident mean‑time‑to‑detect and mean‑time‑to‑recover through improved observability, RCA and runbooks.
Mature AI/ML deployment pipelines with documented governance, monitoring and model lifecycle controls.
High team engagement, evidence of knowledge transfer via deep dive sessions and measurable uplift in engineering capability.
Technical Skills & Experience
Familiar on one or more tech skill.
Strong Java expertise (Java 8/11/17/21/25), demonstrated through large‑scale, production systems.
Deep experience with Spring ecosystem: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data and related tooling.
Microservices and cloud‑native architectures: containerisation (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and 12‑factor app principles.
Event streaming and messaging: Apache Kafka (Kafka Streams, ksqlDB), Confluent tooling and best practices for exactly‑once semantics and fault‑tolerant processing.
Data platform familiarity: batch/stream processing (Spark, Flink), data lakehouse concepts (Delta Lake), and data governance tools (e.g. Apache Atlas, Apache Falcon or equivalent).
AI / ML / LLM productionisation: hands‑on with MLOps and Model frameworks (LangGraph, Agent Development Kit, Microsoft Agent Framework ); experience deploying and operating LLMs (e.g., Falcon family or other LLMs), embeddings, RAG architectures and frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
Observability, reliability and performance engineering: Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK, distributed tracing (Jaeger/Zipkin), profiling and tuning high‑throughput systems.
DevOps, CI/CD :Terraform, Ansible , G3 , and SonarQube.
Cloud platforms: proven experience on at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) in production scale environments.
Security, compliance & risk controls: secure coding practices, threat modelling, encryption, key management and OWASP mitigation patterns.

Job Summary
The role exists to ensure the efficient, controlled and client-focused execution of operational activities that support Wealth Management products, services and client transactions. The role is accountable for delivering operational excellence across core processes while maintaining strong risk and control standards, service quality and regulatory compliance.
Working closely with Front Office teams, Product partners, Risk and Compliance functions, the role oversees operational processes that enable the end-to-end client lifecycle, including onboarding, transaction processing, account maintenance, investment servicing and operational issue resolution. The role ensures service commitments are met while managing operational risks and supporting business growth objectives.
Through effective governance, process optimisation and stakeholder engagement, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience, regulatory compliance and the scalability of Wealth Management operations.
Key Responsibilities
Client & Transaction Operations
Manage Wealth Management operational processes to ensure accurate, timely and controlled execution of client transactions and servicing activities.
Oversee transaction processing, account maintenance and operational support activities to meet agreed service levels and client expectations.
Resolve operational exceptions, enquiries and escalations to minimise client impact and maintain service quality.
Monitor operational performance and capacity to ensure sustainable support for business growth and changing client needs.
Client Lifecycle & Service Delivery
Lead operational activities across client onboarding, account opening, maintenance and closure processes to support a seamless client experience.
Ensure client records, documentation and account information remain accurate, complete and compliant with regulatory requirements.
Coordinate with Front Office, Compliance and Risk teams to facilitate timely completion of client lifecycle activities.
Identify and address service gaps to improve operational efficiency and client outcomes.
Risk, Control & Regulatory Compliance
Maintain effective controls across Wealth Management operations to mitigate operational, regulatory and conduct risks.
Ensure operational activities comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements and established control standards.
Investigate operational incidents, root causes and control weaknesses, implementing corrective actions where required.
Support audits, reviews and regulatory examinations through accurate documentation, reporting and remediation tracking.
Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
Analyse operational performance data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation and efficiency improvements.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity, reduce risk and improve service delivery outcomes.
Establish and monitor key operational metrics, service indicators and management information to support decision-making.
Drive adoption of standardised processes and best practices across Wealth Management Operations.
Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership
Partner with Wealth Management, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance teams to support effective operational delivery.
Provide operational insights and recommendations that inform service improvements, risk mitigation and business decisions.
Facilitate governance forums, operational reviews and stakeholder discussions to drive accountability and action.
Manage stakeholder expectations through clear communication, issue resolution and proactive engagement.
Change Delivery & Operational Readiness
Support implementation of new products, regulatory changes and strategic initiatives by assessing operational impacts and readiness requirements.
Coordinate testing, process updates and operational transition activities to ensure successful implementation.
Embed new controls, procedures and operating models to maintain operational effectiveness.
Monitor post-implementation outcomes and address operational issues arising from change initiatives.
Motivations
Driving operational excellence through process improvement, data-driven insights and scalable solutions that enhance client experience, service quality and risk management.
Solving complex operational challenges by balancing client needs, regulatory requirements and stakeholder expectations while maintaining strong controls and service standards.
Leading high-performing teams and change initiatives that build capability, strengthen operational resilience and support sustainable business growth.
Skills And Experience
Must-have Skills
Investment Management
Account Reconciliation
Custodial Services
Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
Mutual Funds
Product Management
Settlement Management
Tax Management
Financial Services
Stakeholder Engagement
Continuous Improvement
Talent Development
Qualifications
Key Experiences
Experience managing Wealth Management, Private Banking, Investment Operations or related financial services operations.
Experience overseeing client lifecycle, transaction processing, account servicing or investment operations activities.
Demonstrated success implementing operational improvements, productivity enhancements or control strengthening initiatives.
Experience managing operational risk, audit findings, regulatory requirements and remediation activities.
Experience working with Front Office, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
Proven ability to manage operational performance, service levels, governance forums and stakeholder expectations.
Experience leading teams, developing talent and driving a culture of accountability and continuous improvement

Business English

Key Responsibilities
Are you passionate about delivering robust and scalable algorithmic trading stack? Are you motivated to deliver real business value? We are looking for someone to:
Work as part of a Front Office Algo Development team responsible for the delivery of software for the firm’s Agency Trading electronic-trading business, with a focus on the APAC Algos Book-of-Work.
Analyse complex business algorithmic execution requirements, collaborate with Quants, Traders and other global IT teams across regions to design and implement solutions in an agile iterative way.
Help deliver our global platform target-state architecture – implement functionalities and features that enable our global Algo Trading platform to adapt to the APAC Market microstructure; enhance the distributed system architecture to meet our next generation capacity and performance requirements.
Ensure that enterprise requirements on cyber-security, platform hosting and application monitoring are met.
Increase automated testing of distributed algo-engine components; evolve our simulation test-harness to support additional algo and model testing scenarios.
Perform level 3 support and assist production operations team in release related matters.
The team
You will be working in the Front Office Algo Development Team as part of SDL in Shanghai reporting to the APAC Algos Senior / Lead Developer. We are responsible for providing best in class, award winning Execution Trading Algorithms, Smart Order Routing (SOR), Internalization and Direct Market Access for a global client base both internally and externally across Equities, Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) and FX asset classes.

You have:
First class knowledge of Core Java (you are excellent at this); C++, Python and/or KDB experience is a plus.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work with complex, interdependent systems.
Around 5+ years’ experience of developing, delivering and maintaining software in a real-time, event-driven, distributed application environment.
Prior experience in Algo Trading and/or SOR Development is preferred.
Successfully applied solutions to meet non-functional requirements such as stability, capacity, latency, throughput, monitoring and logging.
Hands-on experience of agile software development practices and methodologies, automated testing and CI/CD build and deployment processes.
A proven background in software engineering with a degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or related discipline.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills and a desire to work in a global team.

Passionate about using software to solve complex business problems.

jobs.descriptionText:

Full Time
Job Reference #
327174BR
City
Shanghai
Key Responsibilities
Join a high-performance team building ultra-low latency trading systems where nanoseconds matter. You’ll design and implement a trading rules engine for real-time controls using a hybrid of FPGA hardware and high-performance C++, enabling deterministic execution and rapid interaction with the markets.
Design and implement real-time trading rules and risk checks using FPGA (Verilog/VHDL) or C++.
Architect cycle-accurate FPGA designs and high-speed network interfaces (10/25/40/100GbE, RoCEv2) is preferred.
Build simulation and verification frameworks for FPGA reliability.
Drive full FPGA design flow (synthesis, place & route, timing closure).
Interface C++ applications with FPGA hardware for real-time orchestration.
Implement lock-free data structures and concurrency control in Linux.
Build low-latency network apps using kernel bypass (e.g., Rivermax).
Analyze system performance and resolve latency bottlenecks.
Collaborate with global IT, Quants, and Traders across asset classes.
Provide Level 3 support for production systems.
The team
You’ll be part of the Algorithmic Trading Team based out of Shanghai within the Execution Services, delivering latency-sensitive infrastructure for Algorithmic Execution, Smart Order Routing, Internalization, and Real-time Controls across global markets.
Your Skills And Experience
7+ years in FPGA (Verilog/VHDL) or low-latency C++ development.
Expert in C++17/20/23, Linux system programming, concurrency.
Deep knowledge of FPGA toolchains (Vivado, Quartus), timing closure.
Experience with high-speed networking and hardware acceleration.
Strong background in shared memory IPC and lock-free systems.
